[[Lucasfilm]] treats material from the various [[List of unlicensed sources|unlicensed roleplaying game magazines]] as [[Canon|non-canonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, with the only exceptions being the existence of those [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] and [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] that are referenced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and its [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]], and any other details that were referenced in, and thus canonized by, an official source.</onlyinclude><noinclude>
